// useApi with a query object whose field has the wrong type.
"use client";
import { useApi } from "denext";
import "./.denext/api.ts";

export function Posts() {
  const query = { page: "2" };
  const { data } = useApi("/api/posts", "POST", { body: { title: "x" }, query });
  return <p>{data?.id}</p>;
}
